stanzas.sanskrit:
केशपाशधृतपिञ्छिकाविततिसञ्चलन्मकरकुण्डलं
हारजालवनमालिकाललितमङ्गरागघनसौरभम् ।
पीतचेलधृतकाञ्चिकाञ्चितमुदञ्चदंशुमणिनूपुरं
रासकेलिपरिभूषितं तव हि रूपमीश कलयामहे ॥ ६९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: With peacock feathers adorning HIS hair lock and fish shaped ear-drops, pearl ornaments and variety of garlands on HIS neck, sandal paste on chest and golden chains around HIS hip over the yellow silk dress, stone studded shining anklets on the feet, Bhagwan danced spreading his sweet fragrance everywhere.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावदेव कृतमण्डने कलितकञ्चुलीककुचमण्डले
गण्डलोलमणिकुण्डले युवतिमण्डलेऽथ परिमण्डले ।
अन्तरा सकलसुन्दरीयुगलमिन्दिरारमण सञ्चरन्
मञ्जुलां तदनु रासकेलिमयि कञ्जनाभ समुपादधाः ॥ ६९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The gopikas, who were dressed in their best surrounded Bhagwan Krishna Padmanaabha, the consort of Lakshmi. Krishna took many forms and moved in such a way that he was there between two Gopikas and one Gopika between his two forms alternately and performed the very beautiful RASALEELA.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvadeva kṛtamaṇḍane kalitakañculīkakucamaṇḍale
gaṇḍalolamaṇikuṇḍale yuvatimaṇḍale’tha parimaṇḍale |
antarā sakalasundarīyugalamindirāramaṇa sañcaran
mañjulāṃ tadanu rāsakelimayi kañjanābha samupādadhāḥ || 69-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
वासुदेव तव भासमानमिह रासकेलिरससौरभं
दूरतोऽपि खलु नारदागदितमाकलय्य कुतुकाकुला ।
वेषभूषणविलासपेशलविलासिनीशतसमावृता
नाकतो युगपदागता वियति वेगतोऽथ सुरमण्डली ॥ ६९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Naarada described Bhagwan’s Raas Leela. Hearing about it, groups of Devas & Apsaras from the heaven gathered in the sky to watch the most beautiful dance.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vāsudeva tava bhāsamānamiha rāsakelirasasaurabhaṃ
dūrato’pi khalu nāradāgaditamākalayya kutukākulā |
veṣabhūṣaṇavilāsapeśalavilāsinīśatasamāvṛtā
nākato yugapadāgatā viyati vegato’tha suramaṇḍalī || 69-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
वेणुनादकृततानदानकलगानरागगतियोजना-
-लोभनीयमृदुपादपातकृततालमेलनमनोहरम् ।
पाणिसङ्क्वणितकङ्कणं च मुहुरंसलम्बितकराम्बुजं
श्रोणिबिम्बचलदम्बरं भजत रासकेलिरसडम्बरम् ॥ ६९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The music from the flute was showcasing the alaapanas of the raga of the song played. Matching to the tune, Krishna danced with rhythmic foot steps with Gopikas who were making matching sounds with their bangles. Krishna danced with his lotus like hand on the shoulders of the Gopikas and HIS waist cloth moved swiftly while dancing. Bhattathiri, at this point, calls us to pray to Bhagwan who is performing the RasaLeela.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
veṇunādakṛtatānadānakalagānarāgagatiyojanā-
-lobhanīyamṛdupādapātakṛtatālamelanamanoharam |
pāṇisaṅkvaṇitakaṅkaṇaṃ ca muhuraṃsalambitakarāmbujaṃ
śroṇibimbacaladambaraṃ bhajata rāsakelirasaḍambaram || 69-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रद्धया विरचितानुगानकृततारतारमधुरस्वरे
नर्तनेऽथ ललिताङ्गहारलुलिताङ्गहारमणिभूषणे ।
सम्मदेन कृतपुष्पवर्षमलमुन्मिषद्दिविषदां कुलं
चिन्मये त्वयि निलीयमानमिव सम्मुमोह सवधूकुलम् ॥ ६९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The song reached higher pitch notes successively and the dancers moved delightfully shifting their necklaces and ornaments on their body and even that appeared beautiful. Devas watched with extreme joy showering flowers and got engrossed in the RasaLeela, driving them to divine ecstasy.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śraddhayā viracitānugānakṛtatāratāramadhurasvare
nartane’tha lalitāṅgahāralulitāṅgahāramaṇibhūṣaṇe |
sammadena kṛtapuṣpavarṣamalamunmiṣaddiviṣadāṃ kulaṃ
cinmaye tvayi nilīyamānamiva sammumoha savadhūkulam || 69-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्विन्नसन्नतनुवल्लरी तदनु काऽपि नाम पशुपाङ्गना
कान्तमंसमवलम्बते स्म तव तान्तिभारमुकुलेक्षणा ।
काचिदाचलितकुन्तला नवपटीरसारघनसौरभं
वञ्चनेन तव सञ्चुचुम्ब भुजमञ्चितोरुपुलकाङ्कुरा ॥ ६९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One of the Gopikas who was slender became tired of dancing and with drooping eyes fell on Krishna's shoulders. Another Gopika took Bhagwan’s hand, which had the fragrance of fresh sandal and kissed in ecstasy with goosebumps all over her body.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
svinnasannatanuvallarī tadanu kā’pi nāma paśupāṅganā
kāntamaṃsamavalambate sma tava tāntibhāramukulekṣaṇā |
kācidācalitakuntalā navapaṭīrasāraghanasaurabhaṃ
vañcanena tava sañcucumba bhujamañcitorupulakāṅkurā || 69-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
काऽपि गण्डभुवि सन्निधाय निजगण्डमाकुलितकुण्डलं
पुण्यपूरनिधिरन्ववाप तव पूगचर्वितरसामृतम् ।
इन्दिराविहृतिमन्दिरं भुवनसुन्दरं हि नटनान्तरे
त्वामवाप्य दधुरङ्गनाः किमु न सम्मदोन्मददशान्तरम् ॥ ६९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Another Gopika pressed her cheek against Krishna's cheek and enjoyed the nectar like juice of the betel chewed in HIS mouth. By dancing with Krishna, the Gopikas were driven into higher states of intoxication and supreme bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kā’pi gaṇḍabhuvi sannidhāya nijagaṇḍamākulitakuṇḍalaṃ
puṇyapūranidhiranvavāpa tava pūgacarvitarasāmṛtam |
indirāvihṛtimandiraṃ bhuvanasundaraṃ hi naṭanāntare
tvāmavāpya dadhuraṅganāḥ kimu na sammadonmadadaśāntaram || 69-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
गानमीश विरतं क्रमेण किल वाद्यमेलनमुपारतं
ब्रह्मसम्मदरसाकुलाः सदसि केवलं ननृतुरङ्गनाः ।
नाविदन्नपि च नीविकां किमपि कुन्तलीमपि च कञ्चुलीं
ज्योतिषामपि कदम्बकं दिवि विलम्बितं किमपरं ब्रुवे ॥ ६९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The song and the musical instruments gradually stopped. The Gopikas who were not conscious of themselves were still dancing in circles. The stars in the sky stood still watching this.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gānamīśa virataṃ krameṇa kila vādyamelanamupārataṃ
brahmasammadarasākulāḥ sadasi kevalaṃ nanṛturaṅganāḥ |
nāvidannapi ca nīvikāṃ kimapi kuntalīmapi ca kañculīṃ
jyotiṣāmapi kadambakaṃ divi vilambitaṃ kimaparaṃ bruve || 69-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मोदसीम्नि भुवनं विलाप्य विहृतिं समाप्य च ततो विभो
केलिसम्मृदितनिर्मलाङ्गनवघर्मलेशसुभगात्मनाम् ।
मन्मथासहनचेतसां पशुपयोषितां सुकृतचोदित-
-स्तावदाकलितमूर्तिरादधिथ मारवीरपरमोत्सवान् ॥ ६९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The entire universe was engrossed in divine bliss and ecstasy throughBhagwan’s Rasakreeda and completed it. The Gopikas were glowing with drops of perspiration due to dancing and were totally in pure consciousness of Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
modasīmni bhuvanaṃ vilāpya vihṛtiṃ samāpya ca tato vibho
kelisammṛditanirmalāṅganavagharmaleśasubhagātmanām |
manmathāsahanacetasāṃ paśupayoṣitāṃ sukṛtacodita-
-stāvadākalitamūrtirādadhitha māravīraparamotsavān || 69-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
केलिभेदपरिलोलिताभिरतिलालिताभिरबलालिभिः
स्वैरमीश ननु सूरजापयसि चारु नाम विहृतिं व्यधाः ।
काननेऽपि च विसारिशीतलकिशोरमारुतमनोहरे
सूनसौरभमये विलेसिथ विलासिनीशतविमोहनम् ॥ ६९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The Gopikas were exhausted and hence Krishna took them to river Yamuna and spent time with them. They went around the forest surrounded with cool breeze and beautiful mountains with fragrance of flowers. The Gopikas enjoyed ecstatically.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kelibhedaparilolitābhiratilālitābhirabalālibhiḥ
svairamīśa nanu sūrajāpayasi cāru nāma vihṛtiṃ vyadhāḥ |
kānane’pi ca visāriśītalakiśoramārutamanohare
sūnasaurabhamaye vilesitha vilāsinīśatavimohanam || 69-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कामिनीरिति हि यामिनीषु खलु कामनीयकनिधे भवान्
पूर्णसम्मदरसार्णवं कमपि योगिगम्यमनुभावयन् ।
ब्रह्मशङ्करमुखानपीह पशुपाङ्गनासु बहुमानयन्
भक्तलोकगमनीयरूप कमनीय कृष्ण परिपाहि माम् ॥ ६९-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan made the Gopikas experience the immense bliss of the nectar ocean in the nights. This made even Brahma, Shiva and other Devas a feeling of respect for the Gopikas. Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan to protect him whose beautiful form is achievable only by HIS devotees.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kāminīriti hi yāminīṣu khalu kāmanīyakanidhe bhavān
pūrṇasammadarasārṇavaṃ kamapi yogigamyamanubhāvayan |
brahmaśaṅkaramukhānapīha paśupāṅganāsu bahumānayan
bhaktalokagamanīyarūpa kamanīya kṛṣṇa paripāhi mām || 69-11 ||
